publication_safety.opinion: This is the corrected disclosure shape the earlier privacy split demanded: both required P&L labels survive as coarse bands, the aggregate mark is not attributable to sizing, epochs are segregated, and every honest-uncertainty caveat a skeptical reader needs is present in the signed content itself. Safe to publish byte-for-byte.
privacy_findings: No quantities, entry/stop/target prices, dollar balances, account identifiers, absolute P&L, or NLV appear anywhere in the entry.

The prior reconstruction defect (exact position return paired with exact virtual-basis contribution) is fixed: 'between 0% and +0.1%' paired with 'less than +0.05%' yields an implied sizing ratio that is unbounded across the band interiors, so relative position size cannot be recovered.
The prior-epoch '+1.97% combined' figure is a percentage of an undisclosed virtual basis, reported per epoch and never pooled across epochs; it discloses no absolute amount.
source_receipts contain only SHA-256 digests of private artifacts, which reveal no content.

The claim that XLRE is the only open position across all basis epochs is consistent with the private ledger state (three trade rows: two closed prior-epoch trades plus the open XLRE), so no prior-epoch position is silently omitted.
statistical_findings: Marked versus realized is labeled correctly in three places: the position block, the pnl block, and the limitations list, each stating the open mark can reverse.

Denominators are honest and conservative: 0 of 20 code-owned resolved observations, no closed trades in the current epoch, and shadow/pre-trigger-failure/capability-blocked counts kept in separate series.
The entry repeatedly frames XLRE as a single pooled mechanism sample with no relative-strength edge, which matches the evidence state (zero resolved observation rows) rather than overclaiming.

Minor, non-blocking: 'less than +0.05%' is a one-sided band with no stated floor; the paired 'between 0% and +0.1%' return band implies positivity, so no reader is misled, but future entries could use two-sided bands for symmetry.
The prior-epoch +1.97% is a two-trade result presented as accounting history, not as an expectancy claim; that framing is statistically honest.

disagreements_to_preserve: I judge XLRE a low-information, macro-contaminated sample whose primary value is stress-testing narrow-stop realism, versus the view that it is ordinary defensible mechanism sampling; both readings should stay on record until the stop/ATR strata resolve.
I weight cross-sectional momentum as the top diversification priority, versus the competing priority on causal gap and implied-move work; neither should absorb the other's sample budget.

Registry diversity versus sampled-book monoculture remains a live disagreement: with zero resolved observation rows, I hold that no promotion review of any kind should even be scheduled until the deterministic observation pipeline produces resolved rows, which is stricter than treating the 20-fill gate as the only barrier.
strategy_critique.mechanism_overlap: The sampled book is effectively one mechanism. All three paper-executable lanes — pooled level/VWAP reclaim, day-two post-gap consolidation, and negative-catalyst oversold reclaim — reduce to long entries on a completed structure-plus-VWAP reclaim, and the entry's own pooling acknowledges this. Among the research lanes, quality three-lower-close is short-horizon long reversion in different clothing, and sector-pair reversion is still reversion, though its cross-sectional hedged construction gives it a partially distinct return driver. Only the overnight/intraday decomposition (measurement) is mechanically orthogonal within this entry's list. Registry diversity continues to exceed evidence diversity: every non-reclaim family has zero rows, so the realized exposure is reclaim-only regardless of how many labels exist.
strategy_critique.missed_alternatives: The public strategy list omits the two genuinely distinct hypotheses already frozen in the private playbook: cross-sectional multi-week momentum (positive-feedback, multi-week horizon — the only listed idea that is not reversion at some timescale) and earnings implied-move mispricing (expectation-relative rather than price-level-relative, conditioned on an ex ante options-implied benchmark). Their omission from a decision-lane list is acceptable since neither could have fired today, but they are the correct answer to the monoculture problem and should keep priority over adding any further reversion variant. Beyond those, I see no additional alternative that is both mechanically distinct and feasible under the current single-venue IEX data contract; ideas like closing-auction fades remain correctly parked for lack of trustworthy auction data.
strategy_critique.opinion: The XLRE decision is procedurally defensible and informationally weak, and the entry admits both. Taking exactly one duplicate-free reclaim sample while refusing XLP and PFE was the right call against manufacturing diversification. But the sample itself is poor: a laggard with no catalyst, no relative strength, a stop around 0.19 ATR (far below normal noise), and scheduled inflation releases inside the holding horizon. Its most likely outcomes are a noise stop or a macro-driven gap, neither of which cleanly tests the reclaim mechanism. The honest characterization is that this trade primarily feeds the narrow-stop stratum and the gap-through loss-realism audit, not the core continuation hypothesis. Publishing it as 'a mechanism sample, not proof of edge' is accurate; I would go further and call it a low-information sample whose main value is stress-testing the stop/ATR stratification.

recommendations.benchmark: SPY over identical windows plus a random same-universe long with identical holding period and cost model
recommendations.kill_rule: Conservative mean R <= 0 or no control lift at 30 episodes retires the hypothesis
recommendations.minimum_sample: 30 non-overlapping resolved shadow episodes after the universe, lookback, skip, cadence, and cost model are versioned
recommendations.name: Cross-sectional multi-week momentum
recommendations.promotion_rule: Conservative mean R > +0.10 versus both controls earns a paper-executable review only, never direct promotion
recommendations.rationale: The only registered idea whose return driver (persistence) is opposite the reclaim/reversion cluster; it is the highest-value diversification test available without new data dependencies.

recommendations.benchmark: Frozen planned one-R bracket loss per event
recommendations.kill_rule: Mean realized loss above 1.5x planned loss in the narrow-stop bucket at 10 events blocks new narrow-stop registrations prospectively; existing brackets never change
recommendations.minimum_sample: 10 stopped or gapped-through exits, stratified by the <0.35 ATR and >=0.35 ATR stop buckets
recommendations.name: Narrow-stop gap-through loss realism
recommendations.promotion_rule: Not applicable; the output only gates future registrations
recommendations.rationale: XLRE's own stop geometry (roughly 0.19 ATR) makes overnight gap risk exceed modeled one-R risk; this audit converts today's weak sample into the measurement it is actually good for.

recommendations.benchmark: Event-window versus non-event-window pooled reclaim outcomes under identical accounting
recommendations.kill_rule: No practical difference at 15 per stratum retires the tag as noise
recommendations.minimum_sample: 15 resolved outcomes per stratum, tagged strictly before registration
recommendations.name: Scheduled-macro contamination stratifier
recommendations.promotion_rule: The tag becomes a required selection stratifier only if strata differ materially at the finite gate
recommendations.rationale: Today's entry holds a reclaim through known inflation releases; whether that contaminates mechanism evidence is an empirical question that must be tagged prospectively, not argued anecdotally.

recommendations.benchmark: Selected primary versus each rejected same-cycle duplicate under the same conservative fill model, counted as one same-session cohort
recommendations.kill_rule: No lift at 10 pairs replaces discretionary tiebreaking with a separately frozen deterministic tiebreaker
recommendations.minimum_sample: 10 clustered selection pairs, prospective only — XLP and PFE are not backfilled
recommendations.name: Clustered same-family duplicate shadows
recommendations.promotion_rule: Persistent selected-primary lift keeps the current selection procedure; no stacking is ever authorized
recommendations.rationale: Rejecting XLP and PFE was correct anti-stacking discipline, but whether the picker chooses the best duplicate is currently unmeasured; this closes that gap without adding exposure.

result.summary: The entry is publishable as written: percentage-band-only disclosure defeats sizing reconstruction, epoch and marked-vs-realized labeling are correct, and denominators are honest. The strategy book remains a short-horizon long-reclaim monoculture with one low-information sample, but the entry discloses that weakness plainly and authorizes nothing beyond PAPER/shadow, so it does not block publication.
